subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Branding: discussion and reading ‘A Short History of Branding’ / Grammar Recall: past simple and past simple passive
outcomes: Give your opinion about brand names
Understand a text about the history of branding
Use and recognise the past simple and past simple passive

tf.s: A logo is a small design that is the official symbol of a company.
tf.why: Yes, a logo is a company's symbol.

tf.s: Oman Air's logo is a swirl of frankincense smoke.
tf.why: Correct, it shows an important symbol of Oman.

tf.s: The Chevrolet Nova sold very well in Latin America.
tf.why: It did not sell well because 'no va' means 'it doesn't go' in Spanish.

tf.s: The name 'Adidas' comes from Adolf Dassler's nickname 'Adi' and the first letters of 'Dassler'.
The past simple passive is formed with was/were + past participle.
tf.why: For example: was taken, were introduced.

tf.s: 'Adidas was taken from the name of its founder' is in the past simple active.
tf.why: It uses 'was + taken', so it is past simple passive.

tf.s: Juliet's quotation suggests that a name does not change what something is.
tf.why: That is the main idea of her words.

tf.s: Companies do not care what name they choose for a product.
tf.why: They spend a lot of money choosing the right brand name.

tf.s: 'Did not sell' is a negative past simple verb.
tf.why: Yes, did not + base verb is the negative past simple.

tf.s: We often use the passive when the doer is more important than the action.
tf.why: We use the passive when the action matters more or the doer is unknown.

boxes.q: What is the past simple of 'choose'?
boxes.why: Choose is irregular: choose, chose, chosen.

boxes.q: How do we form the past simple passive?
What does 'no va' mean in Spanish?
boxes.why: That is why the Nova did not sell well.
Frankincense is a symbol of Oman's heritage.

boxes.q: Complete: A new logo ___ by Oman Air.
boxes.why: The logo receives the action, so we use the passive.

boxes.q: Which verb is past simple passive?
Which verb is active past simple?
In a passive sentence, which word shows the agent?
boxes.why: 'By + agent' tells us who did the action.

boxes.q: Who is 'Adi' in the name Adidas?
What do customers use a brand name for?
o: to identify and trust a product
boxes.why: Brand names help people recognise products.

hunt.q: Car that did not sell well

o: a small design that is the official symbol of a company
mcq.why: A logo is a company's official symbol.

mcq.q: Which is the past simple passive?
mcq.why: Were + past participle is the passive.

mcq.q: Why did the Chevrolet Nova not sell well in Latin America?
o: 'no va' means 'it doesn't go' in Spanish
It was only sold in Oman
mcq.why: The name had a bad meaning in Spanish.

mcq.q: Where does the name 'Adidas' come from?
o: Adi (Adolf Dassler's nickname) + Das from Dassler
mcq.why: The founder's name gave the brand its name.

mcq.q: Complete: Branding ______ (not develop) until the 19th century.
mcq.why: Was not + past participle is the negative passive.

mcq.q: Change to passive: Oman Air chose a new logo.
o: A new logo was chosen by Oman Air.
A new logo chose Oman Air.
A new logo was choose by Oman Air.
Oman Air was chosen a new logo.
mcq.why: The object becomes the subject + was + past participle.

mcq.q: Which sentence has a negative past simple verb?
o: The car did not sell well.
mcq.why: Did not + base verb is the negative past simple.

mcq.q: Would companies agree with Juliet that a name is not important?
o: No, because customers use brand names to identify and trust products
Yes, because products have no names
mcq.why: Companies spend a lot on choosing the right name.

mcq.q: Why is the passive used in 'Branding was not developed until the 19th century'?
o: The action matters more than who did it
mcq.why: We do not need to know who developed branding.

mcq.q: Why was frankincense chosen for the Oman Air logo?
o: It is an important symbol of Oman's traditional heritage
mcq.why: Frankincense is still part of life in Oman today.
